title: 수입인지에 관한 법률 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:7:0:00008:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 7 (Fees and Discount Rates)
(1) For the purpose of Article 10, paragraph 1, sub-item (a), the term "the amount as determined by the Minister of Finance and Economy" refers to 40% of the sales price of non-electronic import tax receipts. <Amended July 5, 2017, January 2, 2026>
(2) For the purpose of Article 10, paragraph 2, sub-item (a), the term "the amount as determined by the Minister of Finance and Economy" refers to 20% of the sales price of electronic import tax receipts. <Amended July 5, 2017, January 2, 2026>
(3) For the purpose of Article 11, paragraph 2, the term "the amount as determined by the Minister of Finance and Economy" refers to 20% of the face value of electronic import tax receipts. <Amended January 2, 2026>
